Maya R: Hey folks, quick benefits question. I'm moving from part-time to full-time on 2025-07-01. Do I become eligible for the 401(k) match immediately? Also thinking of starting HSA contributions mid-year  do limits get prorated?

Ben L: Congrats! Short answer: match is per-paycheck on deferrals, so you'll only get match on paychecks where you actually defer after 7/1. No retro proration for earlier part-time earnings.

Jill (Benefits): Vendor specifics: eligibility often follows first-of-month rule. If your status change is effective 7/1, we can enroll you effective 7/1 if forms submitted before payroll cutoff. HSA contribution limits are IRS annual limits; the plan doesn't automatically prorate. If you enroll mid-year you can still aim for the full limit, but consider the last-month rule if using the family plan.

Maya R: If I set a monthly HSA amount that would exceed the IRS limit later in the year, will payroll stop it?

Payroll Bot: Payroll will not auto-stop unless you put an end date or target amount in the ADP benefits-change form. Recommend entering a target amount or calculate monthly = remaining_limit / remaining_pay_periods. Ping payroll and we can monitor for you.

Maya R: Great, thanks. Where's the form?

Ben L: https://redwood.company/adp/forms/benefits-change — pick "Status change" and set 401(k) % + HSA target. Payroll cutoff for July cycle is 2025-06-20 17:00 PT for changes effective 7/1.
